title: Lazarus, Come Forth Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Lazarus, Come Forth Bible Crossword
description: Solve a raising of Lazarus Bible crossword: Bethany, four days in the grave, “Jesus wept”, and the graveclothes. Free KJV puzzles on iPhone and iPad.
prose: A message comes that his friend is sick, and he stays two days longer where he is. By the time he reaches Bethany the man has been in the grave four days, and both sisters say the same sentence to him. Lazarus, Come Forth covers John 11 in full.
The shortest verse in the Bible is in this chapter, and so is one of the largest claims in it. The closing verse is the one he says to Martha before the stone is moved.

clues.text: Town where he lay in the grave

Days he had already been in the grave

verseText: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
